description: This file handles the import process for keywords in the TestLink project. It manages file uploads, determines import types (CSV or XML), initializes page arguments and GUI components, and invokes keyword import functions based on user input. It also contains auxiliary functions for argument parsing and access control.

classes.name: tlKeyword
classes.description: Class representing supported serialization interfaces and formats for keywords.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Class representing test project management functionalities, including importing keywords and retrieving project info.

methods.name: getSupportedSerializationInterfaces
methods.description: Returns array of supported serialization interfaces for keyword data.

methods.name: getSupportedSerializationFormatDescriptions
methods.description: Returns array of format descriptions for supported serialization types.

methods.name: get_by_id
methods.description: Retrieves project data from database by project ID.

methods.name: importKeywordsFromCSV
methods.description: Imports keywords from a CSV file for a specific test project.

methods.name: importKeywordsFromXMLFile
methods.description: Imports keywords from an XML file for a specific test project.
